scope: Narrow read-only review of the reported total GPU memory compatibility change; the v1 full integration review remains separate.

policy.capacity_types: Both values must have exact Python int type; bool and float reject.
policy.admission: Actual reported capacity must be equal to or greater than the training record.
policy.all_other_fields: Field sets and JSON values/types must match exactly, including nested runtime dependencies and environment.

verified_integration: Each worker calls the unchanged hardware validator before this compatibility comparison and before model loading.
The worker records the full actual hardware identity and the comparison, including the additional reported bytes.
The focused author case covers equal capacity, the observed 2 MiB increase, lower capacity, malformed types, changed hardware/runtime/nested fields and the existing limits.
Fresh v2 preparation has identical complete input identity and byte-exact checkpoint, commands, contexts and noise/observation file versus retained v1.
No model, sampler, decoder, source input or training equation changed.
limitations: Readiness review only; no CUDA/model execution or visual-quality result.
Exact-plan parent admission and the external lease/deletion controller remain required; the worker deadline does not terminate provider billing.
